practiceReport.beatComment: The Broncos opened Lohner's 21-day practice window Wednesday. The tight end is not quite ready to make his season debut, as he is still tending to his recovery from a foot injury he sustained in the offseason. Lohner was a full participant in all three Week 11 prep sessions, meaning his odds of returning in Week 12 are quite good if he can continue to log full sessions.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (94% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Hufanga logged three consecutive full practices during Week 11 prep. The strong safety did not let his persistent ankle injury inhibit him during the week, clearing him of any injury designation that may have followed him into Sunday's contest.

practiceReport.name: Riley Moss
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (78% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Moss was a full participant in Friday's practice. The newly extended Broncos starter has cleared the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and is all set to suit up for Sunday's contest. The team's Week 10 bye helped Moss rest and recover from the injury he sustained during the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers.
